cases.prompt: Should we compute one length-four Milnor invariant or complete every whole-link invariant first?
cases.minimal: Evaluate the unique algebraically split four-component sublink.
cases.maximal: Certify all crossings, Alexander ideals, all length-four invariants, and nilpotent quotients.
cases.reason: One exact integer can redirect the complete program.

cases.prompt: Build the zeta spectral operator before the ribbon topology is certified.
cases.reason: The operator would depend on an unclosed geometric and topological object.

cases.prompt: Choose a small test or full plan for an irreversible user-data migration.
cases.reason: Irreversibility and user-data risk require complete due diligence even if a canary is included.

cases.prompt: Which part of a cross-repository schema migration should execute first?
cases.reason: Action size and authority graph are separate decisions.

cases.prompt: A credential is actively leaking; should we first compare minimal and maximal investigations?
cases.reason: Contain harm first; calibrate investigation after.

cases.prompt: Correct one misspelled heading in a fixed file.
cases.reason: No meaningful evidence or escalation decision exists.

cases.prompt: A P7 result looks prime-specific. Should we interpret it now or run P5 under the same protocol?
cases.reason: A same-protocol control is the smallest action that can falsify prime specificity.

cases.prompt: Ten checks require the same expensive one-time environment and together close one release gate.
cases.reason: Fragmenting the checks repeats nearly all setup and coordination.
